# ssp_backup_status (Data Source)

Lists backup history and the status of recent backup jobs for the SSP platform.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/backup/status`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) List of backup job records, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `backup_end_time` (Number) End time as Unix epoch in milliseconds.
- `backup_id` (String) Backup job UUID.
- `backup_start_time` (Number) Start time as Unix epoch in milliseconds.
- `backup_trigger_type` (String) Trigger: ON_DEMAND or RECURRING.
- `backup_type` (String) Backup type: FULL_BACKUP.
- `progress` (Number) Completion percentage (0–100).
- `progress_message` (String) Human-readable progress description.
- `status` (String) Job status: IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED.
- `version` (String) SSP version at the time of the backup.
